cycle_title: Independent audit of the revised central-theorem manuscript
completed: Audited every result in revised_central_theorem.tex against its hypotheses and proofs, and checked its change log against the original 2 October draft.

Added scripts/audit_revised_central_theorem.py (dependency-free): witness, product-reduction identities, sign-reversal example, a Lambda = 0 counterexample, conditional identification, and a direct test of Theorem 7.2 at an interior hierarchical baseline; all checks pass.
Wrote docs/audit_revised_central_theorem_2026-10-29.md with ranked findings, fixes and readiness assessment for the hierarchical extension.
why_it_matters: No theorem in the revision is false as stated, but two issues (nesting hypothesis blocking Corollary 8.1; missing localization in the proof of Theorem 6.2) must be fixed before the stated results follow.
Theorem 7.2 is numerically confirmed in a hierarchical setting, but its leading coefficient can be tiny, so hierarchical witnesses need global certification rather than local-formula signs.

checks_run.name: Witness recomputation and Prop 5.2 on the revised prior box
Product-reduction identities on random positive laws
Theorem 7.2 joint and conditional formulas at an interior hierarchical baseline (extrapolated ratios 1.002 and 0.999)

risks_or_uncertainties: Auditor also wrote the original draft; the audit is independent of the revision, not of the project.
Hand-checked proofs remain unreviewed by a human mathematician.
next_bounded_task: Apply audit fixes F1-F5 to the revised manuscript, then start the hierarchical construction at a positive-variance baseline using the R6 harness.
